subject: design/solution-shape-v1
statement: The solution-shape is a **separate, non-frozen sibling document** of the technical design — the two are authored as a coupled pair and the doc-review surface **renders them together as one review page**, so both are seen in a single review, while **only the design (the Decision) freezes**. The frozen design *references* its shape and never contains it, so the frozen Decision carries no volatile shape (FR-3/M2); the shape is authoritative as the implementation reference until the code that implements it exists, then it is retired. The partition is **by artifact** — durable decisions live in the design (marked by the existing binding markup: `**Decision:**` / `DINV-n` / `A-n`); concrete schema and interfaces live in the shape — and a gate enforces both the split and the pairing. This is *separate at rest, combined at review*, and it reuses two existing seams (the doc-review renderer and the docgate gate) rather than opening a projection pipeline.
